name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true

jobs:
  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-pnpm

      - name: Generate build info
        run: node scripts/generate-build-info.mjs

      - name: Build content
        run: pnpm run build:content-collections

      - name: Typecheck
        run: pnpm run typecheck:ci

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-pnpm

      - name: Generate build info
        run: node scripts/generate-build-info.mjs

      - name: Build content
        run: pnpm run build:content-collections

      - name: Generate feeds
        run: pnpm run generate-feeds

      - name: Upload generated assets
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: generated-assets
          path: |
            .content-collections/
            public/rss/
            src/build-info.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm lint

  unit-tests:
    name: Unit/API Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: [typecheck, lint]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-pnpm

      - name: Download generated assets
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: generated-assets
          path: .

      - name: Run unit/api tests
        run: pnpm test:unit

  worker-tests:
    name: Worker Runtime Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: [typecheck, lint]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-pnpm

      - name: Run worker runtime tests
        run: pnpm test:workers

  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: [typecheck, lint]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-pnpm

      - name: Download generated assets
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: generated-assets
          path: .

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm run build:ci
        env:
          VITE_CI: "1"
          VITE_SITE_URL: "http://127.0.0.1:5045"

      - name: Upload build output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: |
            dist/
            .wrangler/deploy/
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Upload build artifacts on failure
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: failure()

          name

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
